item.title: Asos upskills designers in generative AI to speed up production
item.description: Asos has partnered with GenAI fashion start-up Fermat to upskill more than 100 designers in generative AI and speed up its production process.

item.title: How retail marketers are implementing AI into existing workflows
item.description: The retail marketing industry is awash with artificial intelligence (AI) hype – much of it vague, speculative or fear-driven.
